annotations.title: How Sifter works for a student investment fund

description: How a student-managed investment fund or investing club runs on Sifter (sifter.finance): tracking the fund's real or simulated portfolio, time-weighted returns against a benchmark, attribution and risk limits, stock pitches and votes, reports for a board, faculty advisor oversight, what it costs, how holdings get in, and what stays with the fund after students graduate. Use it when someone asks what Sifter does for a fund or club.
